01 / THE PHILOSOPHY

Less noise.
More ownership.

Your operating system should work for you. Ziuf starts with that simple belief, then builds the architecture to support it.

◎01

Private by intention.

No automatic telemetry. Useful diagnostics are intended to stay on your device, shared only when you choose.

LOCAL-FIRST
⌘02

Independent at the core.

A controlled, source-based Linux foundation. Its own package path and system architecture, built on mature Linux standards.

BUILT WITH PURPOSE
✳03

Freedom to evolve.

Modular components and clear boundaries. A Wayland-first desktop designed to grow without locking the system to one backend.

MODULAR BY DESIGN
02 / THE PLATFORM

Small pieces.
A considered whole.

Explore the building blocks taking shape. These are development directions, with verification before release claims.

One clear package path.

ZPM — Ziuf Package Manager — provides the project's package-management identity, built around a controlled package architecture.
